mapper.select: SELECT ID, FACTORY_CODE, STOCK_DATE, PRODUCT_TYPE_CODE, BRAND, STRUCTURE_NAME, LOCATION_TYPE, MES_MATERIAL_CODE, MATERIAL_CODE, MATERIAL_DESC, STOCK_QTY, WEEK_YEAR, IS_DYNAMIC_BALANCE, IS_UNIFORMITY, IS_EXCEED_THREE_MONTH, IS_EXCEED_SIX_MONTH, IS_EXCEED_NINE_MONTH, IS_EXCEED_TWELVE_MONTH, IS_EXCEED_TIRE, REMARK, IS_DELETE, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_BY, UPDATE_BY, INBOUND_QTY, OUTBOUND_QTY, FINAL_GRADE FROM T_MDM_PRODUCT_STOCK WHERE FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND IS_DELETE = 0 AND stock_date = ( SELECT max(stock_date) FROM T_MDM_PRODUCT_STOCK WHERE factory_code = #{factoryCode} AND IS_DELETE = 0 )
